map.土地基准地价/楼面价计算 使用指南: How to use the land benchmark price / floor price calculator
map.填写「土地用途（参考溢价）」。: Enter the "land use (for the reference premium)".
map.填写「基准地价（元/㎡，选填对比）」。: Enter the "benchmark land price (CNY/m2, optional for comparison)".
map.对比基准地价: Compare with the benchmark land price
map.对比成交价与基准地价的溢价幅度。: Compare the premium of the transaction price over the benchmark land price.
map.拿地前算单位地价与楼面地价判断土地成本。: Before buying land, compute the unit land price and the floor land price to judge the land cost.
map.按容积率测算总建筑面积与单方成本。: Use the plot ratio to compute the total floor area and the cost per unit area.
map.楼面价 = 土地总价/总建筑面积: Floor price = total land cost / total floor area
map.楼面价=土地总价÷总建面，是测算单方开发成本的核心，直接决定售价盈亏平衡线。: Floor price = total land cost / total floor area; it is the core of the per-unit development cost and directly sets the break-even selling price.
map.楼面价为什么关键？: Why is the floor price so important?
map.热点城市溢价 20% 以上常见且偏热，超过 50% 需警惕面粉贵过面包，具体看周: A premium above 20% is common in hot cities and already rich; above 50% be alert for the land costing more than the buildings, and compare with nearby sales prices.
map.输入土地面积、成交价、容积率与建筑密度，计算单位地价、楼面地价，并与基准地价对比: Enter the land area, the transaction price, the plot ratio and the building density to compute the unit land price and the floor land price, and compare against the benchmark land price to assess the premium.
: with a residential benchmark land price of 6000 CNY/m² and a unit land price of 5000 CNY/m² here, the discount is about 16.7%; if the floor price of 2000 is below the surrounding cost line, the project is viable.
map.：成交总价 5000 万、土地面积 1 万㎡、容积率 2.5 → 单位地价=50: : with a total transaction price of 50 million, a land area of 10,000 m² and a plot ratio of 2.5 -> unit land price = 50/1 = 5000 CNY/m²; total floor area = 1×2.5 = 25,000 m²; floor land price = 5000/2.5 = 2000 CNY/m².
